name: geo-tool-check
description: Check whether a page can be read and cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and Google AI. Runs entirely on this machine — no API key, no account.
long_description:
Three tools for AI search visibility. check_ai_readiness scores a public page across six categories using the same code that powers geo-tool.com. check_ai_crawlers reads a domain's robots.txt and reports which AI crawlers are blocked. check_citability scores a passage while drafting, without any network request.

Every fetch goes from this machine straight to the target site; nothing is sent to geo-tool.com. Node executes no JavaScript, so the result reflects what a plain HTML crawler sees — which is exactly what GPTBot, ClaudeBot and PerplexityBot see.

tools.name: check_ai_readiness
tools.description: Score a public web page on whether AI search systems can read, understand and cite it. Returns 0-100 across six categories plus findings.

tools.name: check_ai_crawlers
tools.description: Read a domain's robots.txt and report which AI crawlers are fully blocked — GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and others.

tools.name: check_citability
tools.description: Score a passage of text or HTML on how likely an AI answer is to quote it. Makes no network request.
